As per estimates by the National Statistical Office (NSO) and guidance from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), India's GDP growth for FY26 is expected to be in the range of 7.4-7.6%, reflecting strong and broad-based economic momentum, despite global uncertainties such as geopolitical tensions and fluctuating commodity prices.
The Government is targeting a fiscal deficit at 4.4% of GDP for FY26 with a target of bringing it down to 4.3% of GDP in FY27.
Growth & demand: The IMF projects global GDP growth of 3.1% in CY26 compared to 3.2% in CY25.
Revenue increased by 2% year-on-year to ₹473 crore in FY26 from ₹463 crore in FY25, reflecting the resilience of our business model amid an evolving market environment.
Reflecting these headwinds, the WTO has projected global trade volume growth at a modest 3.3% in CY26, indicating only a gradual recovery amid persistent geopolitical and policy uncertainties.
